translations: 商家选择 Uber Eats，是为了接触新顾客并增加收入。商家也希望日常运营工具更简单。我们认真听取了这些反馈，正在推出人工智能、实时沟通和商家社区共创内容等新功能，帮助商家长期经营。

fullTextParagraphs: With more than 1.5 million merchants on Uber Eats – across more than 11,000 cities and six continents – we’re constantly innovating to build new products and features to help restaurants, grocers, and retailers grow their businesses and boost earnings.

In 2024 alone, hundreds of thousands of U.S. restaurants and retailers used Uber Eats to generate additional income – contributing to economic growth in communities nationwide. Today, we’re releasing our 2025 Merchant Impact Report, offering insights into what matters most to our merchant partners and how Uber Eats helps support their growth.

Merchants choose Uber Eats to reach new customers and grow their revenue. They’ve also asked for tools that make daily operations simpler, and we’re committed to taking that feedback to heart. Now, we’re rolling out new features powered by AI, real-time communication, and community-driven content to support merchants in their long-term success. Here’s what’s coming:

Merchants are already seeing the benefits of AI, with 78% of those who use AI tools saying they’re effective. Now, we’re introducing a suite of new AI features to help restaurants analyze customer reviews, auto-fill menu descriptions, and enhance food photos:

Summarize Customer Reviews: This new AI-powered feature helps restaurants quickly distill insights from customer reviews – highlighting areas for improvement and strengths to lean into – making it easier to understand feedback at scale.
Menu Descriptions: AI-generated item descriptions make it easier for restaurants to complete their menus, while also helping customers feel confident in their choices.

Enhance Food Photos: We’re using AI to detect and enhance low-quality food images – improving lighting, resolution, framing, and plating – to help restaurants showcase their dishes more accurately while elevating the customer experience from discovery to checkout.

We know customers are more likely to order a dish when they can see what it looks like – so we’re introducing a new feature that invites Uber Eats users to snap a photo of their delivery if the item doesn’t yet have a menu image. And in the U.S., Canada, Mexico, and the U.K., customers may receive Uber Cash for select dishes if their photo is published. In the U.S., customers can get $3 in UberCash! Just tap “Add Photos” on the rate order screen after your delivery to get started.

We’re launching a new tool that lets merchants initiate chats directly with customers once an order has been received – helping to prevent issues before they arise. Live order chat can help improve order accuracy by enabling real-time communication to confirm replacements for out-of-stock items, clarify special requests, and check in on dietary or allergy preferences.
With smarter, more intuitive tools shaped by merchant feedback, we’re elevating the Uber Eats experience for both the businesses we serve and the communities they nourish.

scenario.title: 模拟情境：缺货和特殊要求经常拖慢订单
english: Several restaurant partners say they lose time when an item is out of stock or a customer adds a special request.
Your team is introducing live order chat so merchants can contact customers after an order comes in.
Explain what the tool does and how it may improve order accuracy.
chinese: 几家餐厅商家反映，商品缺货或顾客提出特殊要求时，订单处理会变慢。
你的团队正在推出实时订单聊天，商家接单后可以联系顾客。
请说明工具的作用，以及它如何帮助提高订单准确率。

firstAttempt.prompt: 你向餐厅商家介绍实时订单聊天功能。请说明商家遇到的一个问题、功能如何解决，以及预期的经营帮助。
firstAttempt.sample: We heard from merchants that out-of-stock items can lead to order problems. Live order chat lets your team confirm a replacement with the customer as soon as an order comes in. That should help improve order accuracy and prevent avoidable issues.
firstAttempt.rationale: 把商家反馈、功能动作和业务结果连起来。

words.example: We’re adding tools to help merchant partners manage orders.
words.translation: 我们正在增加帮助商家管理订单的工具。

words.example: We distill insights from customer reviews each month.
words.translation: 我们每月从顾客评价中提炼信息。

words.example: The customer approved a replacement for the missing item.
words.translation: 顾客同意用替换品替代缺货商品。

taskPhrases.meaning: 我们从商家那里了解到……
taskPhrases.collocation: We heard from + group + that + issue
taskPhrases.example: We heard from merchants that out-of-stock items can delay orders.
taskPhrases.translation: 我们从商家那里了解到，商品缺货会延误订单。

taskPhrases.example: The feature lets your team confirm substitutions with customers.
taskPhrases.translation: 这项功能可让团队和顾客确认替换商品。

taskPhrases.example: That should help reduce incorrect orders.
taskPhrases.translation: 这样有助于减少错误订单。

structure.original: Live order chat can help improve order accuracy by enabling real-time communication to confirm replacements for out-of-stock items, clarify special requests, and check in on dietary or allergy preferences.
analysis: can help improve…说明功能可能带来的结果。
by 后面用动名词说明实现结果的方式。
confirm、clarify、check in 具体列出沟通动作。
structure.transfer: The shared dashboard can help reduce missed updates by showing every open request in one place.

rewrite.good: We heard from merchants that out-of-stock items can lead to order problems. Live order chat lets your team confirm a replacement with the customer as soon as an order comes in. That should help improve order accuracy and prevent avoidable issues.
rewrite.translation: 我们从商家那里了解到，商品缺货会导致订单问题。实时订单聊天可让团队在接单后立即与顾客确认替换商品。这样有助于提高订单准确率，避免可以提前处理的问题。
rewrite.pattern: We heard from [customers] that [problem]. [Feature] lets your team [action]. That should help [business outcome].

cloze.prompt: We heard from merchants ______ out-of-stock items can delay orders.
cloze.why: that 引出商家反馈的具体问题。

cloze.prompt: The feature ______ your team confirm a replacement with the customer.
cloze.why: let + someone + 动词原形，说明功能允许用户做什么。
order accuracy 指订单内容与顾客要求相符。

translationPractice.prompt: 我们从商家那里了解到，商品缺货会延误订单。
translationPractice.answer: We heard from merchants that out-of-stock items can delay orders.
translationPractice.why: 用 We heard from... 介绍商家反馈，把问题放在功能介绍之前。

translationPractice.prompt: 这项功能可让团队和顾客确认替换商品。
translationPractice.answer: The feature lets your team confirm substitutions with customers.
translationPractice.why: 说明实时聊天如何让商家与顾客确认替代商品。

translationPractice.prompt: 这样有助于减少错误订单。
translationPractice.answer: That should help reduce incorrect orders.
translationPractice.why: 用 should help 表达预期帮助，不把效果说成已经验证的结果。

choice.prompt: 餐厅商家担心缺货时容易发错订单。哪种介绍最清楚？
options: Our feature is great and innovative.
We heard that substitutions can cause order issues. Live order chat lets your team confirm replacements with customers, which should help improve order accuracy.
You should ask customers to order something else.
choice.why: 第二种说法将商家问题、功能动作和预期结果连在一起。

output.prompt: 一家餐厅反映顾客经常找不到菜品信息。请介绍菜单描述功能，说明它能帮助商家补充菜品介绍，并让顾客更容易作出选择。
output.sample: We heard from restaurant partners that customers need clearer item details when they browse the menu. The menu description tool helps restaurants add information about each dish, so customers can choose what to order with more confidence.
check: 说明顾客可能获得的帮助
